# alternation: search-pattern alternations of words and short ids in shell, python, rust and js.
# an alternation lists independent items: each is a word run or a short id (a digit, or both cases)
# below the 20-byte minimum, or a longer identifier. one `(` or `(?:` group and `^`, `$`, `\b`
# anchors may wrap the list and each item.
# known gap: a grep basic-regex alternation such as `word\|word` and an inline flag group such as
# `(?i)word|word` are reported, because the escaped pipe and the flag group are not item bytes.
# known gap: a single-case acronym item of four or more letters without a vowel, such as `HTML`,
# is not a word run, so an alternation containing one is reported.

# a search pattern of several groups, anchors and posix classes whose literal runs are words.
# known gap: a pattern with fewer than three words of four or more letters (`(^|/)(target|dist)$`)
# or with four short alternatives in a row (`(ls|cat|head|less)`) is reported, as a chunked token is.
